routes.name: Residence Visa – Personnel employed in a Private Sector Company

note: Sri Lanka, read on the Department of Immigration and Emigration's own page on residence visas on 2026-10-30. A residence visa is issued for the purpose of its category; for personnel employed by a private sector company it is applied for at the Department in Colombo on the company's request letter and papers and the line ministry's recommendation (so tied to the company), valid for one year or the period the authority recommends, and renewable annually on the line ministry's recommendation. A performer on a short engagement takes the business purpose visa for art, music and dance events (the work engine's route). Fees are on a separate page not read; the Resident Guest Scheme, permanent residence and naturalisation's count aren't written.

sources.title: Department of Immigration and Emigration, Residence Visa
sources.said: A Residence Visa is a permit for a non-Sri Lankan to obtain residence facilities for special purposes. ... Personnel employ in a Private Sector Company and their dependents ... You can submit visa application to the Department of Immigration and Emigration, Colombo. ... Request Letter from the representing Company/Institute Company Registration Certificate ... Your residence visa is valid for one year or time period recommended by the respective authority.It can be renewed annually .
